subject: Hosted API commit uplift — proposed rollup plan, compliance, and PO path
messages:
From: Clara Jensen <clara@midrange.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API capacity & commit for 2027 renewal

Hi Vivek,

Hope you had a good weekend. We're kicking off our renewal conversations for the Jun 1 renewal date and wanted to flag that usage has been trending +45% month-over-month for Q1. Our forecasting team expects a sustained increase and we'd like to discuss a higher monthly commit (rough target 2.5x current) to secure better unit pricing and a steadier latency SLA.

Key asks from our side:
- A staged commit uplift that lets us ramp without heavy penalties.
- Clear soft-throttle behavior if we spike beyond commit.
- Confirmation of data controls and SOC2 evidence for our security team.
- Target timeline: signed amendment + PO in the next 3 weeks.

Can you share a recommended path (pricing bands, throttle policy, draft redline language) and who we should loop from your side for procurement and legal?

Thanks,
Clara

--
Clara Jensen
Head of Platform
MidRange AI
clara@midrange.ai

Attachment: forecast_Q1_Q2.xlsx (stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Clara Jensen <clara@midrange.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API capacity & commit for 2027 renewal

Clara — thanks for the heads up and the forecast. Congrats on the growth — happy to help make this predictable for you.

High-level response:
1) Staged uplift: we typically do a two-phase amendment — an initial uplift to ~1.5x with a pre-negotiated path to 2.5x after 60 days subject to usage verification. That minimizes immediate cash impact while locking better rates.
2) Soft-throttle: we can offer a soft-throttle window where excess is metered at a discounted overage tier for up to 30 days, then a hard throttle or automatic fallback to a compatible, lower-cost model if sustained. We'll include clear burst buckets so you can run spikes without interruptions.
3) Compliance: attaching our latest SOC2 report and a short SOW template with the uplift language. Marissa — can your legal team prep a short amendment and SOW redline?
4) Ops: Karthik, can you confirm whether the requested 2.5x needs dedicated capacity or if we can satisfy it in hosted with burst lanes? Also call out any latency SLO variance.

Next steps: I'll draft the uplift playbook and pricing matrix and share by EOD tomorrow. If this fits, we can send a DocuSign amendment + SOW and accept PO.

Best,
Vivek
VP, Revenue — Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: SOC2_report_Q4_2026.pdf (stub), uplift_playbook_draft.xlsx (stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Clara Jensen <clara@midrange.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API capacity & commit for 2027 renewal

Vivek / Clara — quick technical ops note from my side.

We can support MidRange's projected 2.5x in hosted mode using the following configuration:
- Baseline: commit uplift to 1.5x on current SKU, enable auto-burst with a 30-day discounted surge bucket (50% discount to standard overage).
- Phase 2: after 60 days, if usage verifies, we formalize a permanent 2.5x commit.
- Impact on latency: under continuous sustained 2.5x we estimate median latency to increase ~8–12% on peak windows unless we reserve dedicated capacity. If stricter P95 latency is required, recommend switching to Dedicated for the additional headroom — we can propose a hybrid where core traffic is on Dedicated and occasional bursts use hosted lanes.

Operational asks for MidRange:
- Provide expected hourly distribution for production traffic (csv) so we can tune batching/kv cache.
- Confirm whether any region-specific pinning required (you listed US; confirm preferences).

I'll update the uplift_playbook_draft with two SKU scenarios (hosted+burst vs hybrid dedicated) and the expected cost delta by EOD.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Platform Ops — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Clara Jensen <clara@midrange.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API capacity & commit for 2027 renewal

Vivek / team — legal ops here.

I'll take the lead on the amendment and SOW redline. A few items we'll include explicitly:
- Ramp schedule language (1.5x initial, verification window, auto-escalate to 2.5x).
- Soft-throttle definition and customer notifications (we'll include a 72-hour notice before hard throttle unless spikes are extreme).
- Billing treatment for burst buckets and how credits are applied if you convert to a higher commit mid-cycle.
- Term: keep the overall contract term aligned to Jun 1 renewal date; amendment will state effective date and billing proration.

Clara — can you confirm the billing entity and whether you require a separate SOW for the hybrid/dedicated option? Also, procurement often asks for vendor W-9 and PO contact — please send to stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com.

I'll circulate a redline by tomorrow morning.

—Marissa
Sr. Counsel, Contracts — Redwood Inference

From: Clara Jensen <clara@midrange.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops@midrange.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 10:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API capacity & commit for 2027 renewal

Thanks all — this looks like the right approach. Quick replies inline:
- Billing entity: MidRange AI, Inc. (EIN: 27-XXXXXXX). Procurement will issue a PO; ops@midrange.ai is copied.
- We prefer the two-phase uplift (1.5x then 2.5x) with the discounted surge bucket you proposed. That keeps our cash flow predictable.
- Latency: we'll start on hosted+burst; if variance >10% over a rolling 7-day window we'll revisit Dedicated. Please include the hybrid SOW option.
- Compliance: SOC2 report received (thanks). Procurement will still request a brief attestation for data retention and encryption-at-rest details.

Can you send the redline + DocuSign envelope and we'll aim to turn the PO around within 10 business days?

Best,
Clara
